profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, trading under the ticker ZBRA. On its website, the company describes itself as providing a foundation for intelligent operations, with mobile computers, scanners, printers, RFID, and related hardware to digitize, automate, and improve processes.

The site highlights two AI-related offerings. Zebra Frontline AI Enablers is described as providing AI vision models, sample applications, and streamlined API workflows for business processes. Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints is described as offering adaptable, real-world AI frameworks that automate manual tasks and drive efficiency in high-pressure frontline operations.

Illinois records list 374 legal matters involving the company. SEC records identify it under CIK 0000877212.
